method: official MEXC Futures pages via gstack /browse; one separate bounded public ticker probe by root

documented.rest_ticker: symbol optional; 10 requests/2s; bid1/ask1; volume24 contracts; amount24 turnover; timestamp trade time
documented.rest_depth: symbol required; optional limit; 10 requests/2s; asks/bids, version, system timestamp
documented.contract_info: symbol optional; 10 requests/2s; state, futureType, apiAllowed, base/quote/settle and contract/risk rules
documented.ws_all_tickers: public sub.tickers; all perpetual contracts; approximately 2s push; sample data list; volume24 contracts and amount24 currency turnover
documented.ws_single_ticker: public sub.ticker exact symbol; approximately 1s when trades occur; bid1/ask1 and 24h volume/turnover fields
documented.ws_depth: public sub.depth exact symbol; approximately 200ms updates; version, matching-engine cts, outer ts
documented.ws_connection: wss://contract.mexc.com/edge; ping every 10-20s; no ping for 1 minute closes connection
